# pangolin_redirects (Data Source)

Lists the redirects of the organization, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every enabled permanent redirect, with the resource it is attached to.
data "pangolin_redirects" "permanent" {
  type    = "permanent"
  enabled = true
}

output "permanent_redirects" {
  value = { for r in data.pangolin_redirects.permanent.redirects : r.name => r.destination_host }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Only return redirects attached to this domain.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only return enabled (`true`) or disabled (`false`) redirects.
- `query` (String) Only return redirects matching this text (case-insensitive) in its name, match path or destination host.
- `resource_id` (Number) Only return redirects attached to this resource.
- `type` (String) Only return `permanent` (308) or `temporary` (307) redirects.

### Read-Only

- `redirects` (Attributes List) List of redirects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redirects))

<a id="nestedatt--redirects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redirects`

Read-Only:

- `base_domain` (String) Base domain of `domain_id`, or `null`.
- `destination_host` (String) Where requests are redirected to.
- `domain_id` (String) The domain the redirect is attached to, or `null`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The numeric redirect ID.
- `match_path` (String) The path to match, or `null`.
- `name` (String) The redirect name.
- `nice_id` (String) Readable ID, unique per org.
- `path_match_type` (String) How `match_path` is matched: `exact`, `prefix` or `regex`.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is permanent (308) rather than temporary (307).
- `priority` (Number) Matching priority, or `null`.
- `resource_full_domain` (String) Full domain of the attached resource, or `null`.
- `resource_id` (Number) The resource the redirect is attached to, or `null`.
- `resource_name` (String) Name of the attached resource, or `null`.
- `resource_nice_id` (String) Nice ID of the attached resource, or `null`.
- `rewrite_path` (String) The rewritten path, or `null`.
- `rewrite_path_type` (String) How the path is rewritten, or `null`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is served over HTTPS.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain, or `null`.
